title: Test that an over-limit label fails no catalog search filtered by --label that wouldn't select its item
outcome: Test that an over-limit label fails no catalog search filtered by --label that wouldn't select its item
acceptance: A test gives one item a label whose case-folded key is over the catalog's unit limit (for example U+0130 repeated to 0.4 of the limit), and shows that `ls --label` with a search that doesn't select that item succeeds.
